fail_closed_rules.rule: Repository-local .brownie/modepack.json and .brownie/AgentModes/workflow.yaml inputs are UntrustedRepositoryLocal unless distribution evidence validates.
Runtime must not select TrustedSignedActiveModePack when pinned commit, artifact hash, signature, trust root, or revocation evidence is missing, stale, mismatched, or revoked.

UntrustedRepositoryLocal Mode Packs cannot grant llm_provider_access, network_access, workspace_write, process_exec, git_inspect, git_commit, subtask spawning, or MCP execution by declaring those fields.
network_access remains false for external Mode Packs in v0 even when source trust and ceiling are otherwise satisfied.
A revoked signer, trust root, commit, tag, artifact, or Mode Pack fingerprint fails validation before activation.

pinned_commit.description: Immutable Git commit id used to fetch and compile the distributed Mode Pack.

mode_pack_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the compiled Mode Pack snapshot selected for activation.

artifact_sha256.description: Hash of the fetched Mode Pack artifact or archive.

signature.description: Detached signature or equivalent owner-approved integrity proof.

trust_root.description: Owner-approved trust root used to verify the signature or integrity proof.

revocation_evidence.description: Bounded revocation check result for signer, trust root, commit/tag, artifact, and Mode Pack fingerprint.
